finalText:
**About 1291 hits in 94 files. Four zones must not change.**

| Zone | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` (20) | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` (5) plus the `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Public field name. Renaming breaks every client. |
| `migrations/*.sql`, all applied (61) | History. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `account_id` inside repo SQL strings | Real DB column. Needs its own migration. |

The rest is service JS, roughly 1200 hits. That part is mechanical.

Also check `req.session.account_id` and the audit key in [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8). Both cross a system boundary.

Next: ask if the DB column is in scope. That answer splits this into one PR or three.
